scenes.picture: At a scout camp in the pine woods, a silly queen holds up a round stitched patch with a glowing page sewn onto it, next to a tent, while a goofy crow points.

sentences.text: Vex has a big patch.
The spell is on the patch!
Vex will stitch it to a tent.
Catch the patch!

scenes.picture: In a scout camp, a silly queen peeks out of a hedge by a little wooden bridge, holding a shiny gold badge, while a hedgehog sits on a ledge.

sentences.text: Vex is in the hedge.
Chip ran on the bridge.
A hedgehog is on the ledge.
Vex made the patch a badge!

scenes.picture: In the cold, wild pine woods, a cheerful boy carries a baby on his back, and a goofy crow points up at something gold in a tall tree.

sentences.text: It is cold in the camp.
Bix will hold the child.
Can we find the gold badge?
Gus is kind to Nell.

scenes.picture: At the top of a tall pine tree, a silly queen with a gold badge on her hat sits on a branch, and a goofy crow flies up to her across the sky.

sentences.text: Gus can fly up to Vex.
Try to get the badge, Gus!
Vex and Gus are in the sky.

scenes.picture: By a pond in a scout camp, a teddy bear and a rag doll share candy with a happy baby, and a little kitten in a wizard hat dances, while a badge glows under the water.

sentences.text: Nell is a happy baby.
Ted and Dot have candy.
The cat is silly and jolly.
The badge is in the pond!

scenes.picture: At the edge of a pond, a clever girl holds a little candle, bubbles rise, a child lifts out a glowing badge, and a silly queen slips into a puddle.

sentences.text: Tess has a little candle.
Bubbles pop in the puddle.
You can grab the badge!
Vex fell in the puddle.
You got the spell!

side.picture: By a campfire, a bouncy boy stirs a pot of fudge, and a small stuffed elephant sits in the fudge pot, sticky and happy, refusing to move.

sentences.text: Chip has a batch of fudge.
Phil has fudge on his trunk.
Phil will not budge!

side.picture: In a big camp tent, a baby does a jigsaw puzzle on a little table, and a very big sleepy cat naps right on top of the table.

sentences.text: Thud has a puzzle.
Nell will help with the puzzle.
Thud had a nap on the table.
